text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, it was 
announced that Mejiro McQueen would enter 
a prolonged rest period due to issues with 
her leg.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Mejiro McQueen declared that she 
would definitely return. Believing her 
words, Ikuno Dictus promised to keep on 
running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Queen Elizabeth II Cup. 
Ikuno Dictus is in great shape. She takes 
on the race to make the fruits of her 
experience blossom!
